neighbours.label: Digits in a parenthetical metric conversion following a measurement in miles.
fire: The coastal trail stretches 30 miles (48 km) through the hills.
The bird can fly 75 miles (121 km) without stopping.
The two towns are 60 miles (97 km) apart by road.
The crater measures 20 miles (32 km) across its rim.
The mountain range extends 100 miles (161 km) to the north.
The ship traveled 40 miles (64 km) along the coast.
The island lies 15 miles (24 km) from the mainland.
The signal was visible 50 miles (80 km) from the tower.
quiet: The coastal trail stretches 30 miles; its metric length is 48 km.
The bird can fly 75 miles; that distance equals 121 km.
The two towns are 60 miles apart; the road distance is 97 km.
The crater measures 20 miles across; its diameter is 32 km.
The mountain range extends 100 miles northward; that is 161 km.
The ship traveled 40 miles along the coast; that is 64 km.
The island lies 15 miles from the mainland; the distance is 24 km.
The signal was visible 50 miles from the tower; that is 80 km.

predictions: The fire set is predicted to outrank the matched near misses under quick-8+8@2; this card-derived hypothesis may fail.
notes: Several card peaks occur on the first digits of a kilometre conversion after miles. Controls retain both measurements but put them in separate clauses.
